+import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Combining.Lines.Sampling
+import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Combining.Points.MarginalContraction
+
+/-!
+# Point and line marginal comparisons
+
+Projection contraction and the original line-point law give the two marginal
+comparisons used by the X-Z-X line construction.
+
+## References
+
+Paper `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:882-963`,
+blueprint `lem:qld-xz-lines`. The source and completed-answer distinctions are
+documented in `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_combined-lines-error-term.tex`.
+-/
+
+namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
+
+open MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
+open MIPStarRE.Quantum MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus
+open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder
+
+noncomputable section
+
+/-- The point marginal of the line-point law is uniform. This is the
+formalization-only averaging step in `eq:pasting-q1`, paper
+`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:936-941`, using `lem:alnf` and `lem:dlnf`. -/
+theorem avgOver_linePointDist_point (L : LdParams)
+    (value : (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L) → ℝ) :
+    avgOver (linePointDist L) (fun sample => value sample.2) =
+      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L)) value := by
+  rw [linePointDist, avgOver_mix]
+  rw [← Distribution.avgOver_map (aLinePointDist L) Prod.snd value,
+    ← Distribution.avgOver_map (dLinePointDist L) Prod.snd value,
+    (aLinePointDist_point_marginal_uniform L).1,
+    (dLinePointDist_point_marginal_uniform L).1]
+  ring
+
+/-- Independent line-point samples have independent uniform point marginals.
+This formalization-only identity transports the point estimates in
+`eq:pasting-q1`, paper `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:936-941`. -/
+theorem avgOver_prod_linePointDist_points (L : LdParams)
+    (value : (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L) × (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L) → ℝ) :
+    avgOver (Distribution.prod (linePointDist L) (linePointDist L))
+      (fun sample => value (sample.1.2, sample.2.2)) =
+      avgOver (uniformDistribution
+        ((Fin L.m → ScalarQ L) × (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L))) value := by
+  rw [uniformDistribution_prod, avgOver_prod, avgOver_prod]
+  conv_lhs =>
+    arg 2
+    ext sample
+    rw [avgOver_linePointDist_point L (fun point => value (sample.2, point))]
+  exact avgOver_linePointDist_point L
+    (fun point => avgOver (uniformDistribution _) (fun other => value (point, other)))
+
+/-- The first postprocessed joint-point effect is its X marginal sum.
+This is the definition preceding `eq:qld-qxz-close-to-point`, paper
+`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:917-932`, not a witness assumption. -/
+theorem CombinedPointsWitness.postprocess_fst_effect
+    {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε δQ : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P ε}
+    (points : CombinedPointsWitness S δQ) (side : PlayerSide)
+    (x z : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) (a : PauliScalar P) :
+    ((points.Q side x z).postprocess Prod.fst).effect a =
+      ∑ b, (points.Q side x z).effect (a, b) := by
+  classical
+  change (∑ pair ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun pair => pair.1 = a),
+    (points.Q side x z).effect pair) = _
+  simp only [Finset.sum_filter, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
+  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
+  simp
+
+/-- The second postprocessed joint-point effect is its Z marginal sum.
+Source: `eq:qld-qxz-close-to-point-2`, paper
+`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:933-935`. -/
+theorem CombinedPointsWitness.postprocess_snd_effect
+    {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε δQ : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P ε}
+    (points : CombinedPointsWitness S δQ) (side : PlayerSide)
+    (x z : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) (b : PauliScalar P) :
+    ((points.Q side x z).postprocess Prod.snd).effect b =
+      ∑ a, (points.Q side x z).effect (a, b) := by
+  classical
+  change (∑ pair ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun pair => pair.2 = b),
+    (points.Q side x z).effect pair) = _
+  simp [Finset.sum_filter, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
+
+/-- X marginal distance on the product line-point law, retaining the supplied
+point error. This is the first transport step of `eq:pasting-q1`, paper
+`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:936-941`; no line comparison is assumed. -/
+theorem CombinedPointsWitness.marginal_X_linePoint_distance_le
+    {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε δQ : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P ε}
+    (points : CombinedPointsWitness S δQ)
+    (p1 p2 : Placement) (hopp : p1.IsOpposite p2) :
+    opFamilyDistSq (Distribution.prod (linePointDist P.toLdParams)
+      (linePointDist P.toLdParams))
+      (fun sample a => S.place p1
+        (((points.Q p1.side sample.1.2 sample.2.2).postprocess Prod.fst).effect a))
+      (fun sample a => S.place p2 ((S.pointMeasExp p2.side .X sample.1.2).effect a))
+      S.psiHat ≤ 4 * δQ := by
+  classical
+  simp_rw [points.postprocess_fst_effect, S.place_finset_sum]
+  unfold opFamilyDistSq
+  rw [avgOver_prod_linePointDist_points P.toLdParams (fun xz =>
+    ∑ a, ‖applyOperatorToState
+      ((∑ b, S.place p1 ((points.Q p1.side xz.1 xz.2).effect (a, b))) -
+        S.place p2 ((S.pointMeasExp p2.side .X xz.1).effect a)) S.psiHat‖ ^ 2)]
+  exact points.marginal_X_distance_le p1 p2 hopp
+
+/-- Z marginal distance on the product line-point law, with the same error as
+the uniform-point estimate. Source: `eq:pasting-q1`, paper
+`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:936-941`. -/
+theorem CombinedPointsWitness.marginal_Z_linePoint_distance_le
+    {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε δQ : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P ε}
+    (points : CombinedPointsWitness S δQ)
+    (p1 p2 : Placement) (hopp : p1.IsOpposite p2) :
+    opFamilyDistSq (Distribution.prod (linePointDist P.toLdParams)
+      (linePointDist P.toLdParams))
+      (fun sample b => S.place p1
+        (((points.Q p1.side sample.1.2 sample.2.2).postprocess Prod.snd).effect b))
+      (fun sample b => S.place p2 ((S.pointMeasExp p2.side .Z sample.2.2).effect b))
+      S.psiHat ≤ 4 * δQ := by
+  classical
+  simp_rw [points.postprocess_snd_effect, S.place_finset_sum]
+  unfold opFamilyDistSq
+  rw [avgOver_prod_linePointDist_points P.toLdParams (fun xz =>
+    ∑ b, ‖applyOperatorToState
+      ((∑ a, S.place p1 ((points.Q p1.side xz.1 xz.2).effect (a, b))) -
+        S.place p2 ((S.pointMeasExp p2.side .Z xz.2).effect b)) S.psiHat‖ ^ 2)]
+  exact points.marginal_Z_distance_le p1 p2 hopp
+
+/-- Completing both answer alphabets with a zero outcome preserves placed
+squared distance. This formalization-only identity reconciles `eq:pasting-q1`
+with the completed evaluation convention of `lem:qld-comm-line-cons`. -/
+theorem ProjectiveSetting.opFamilyDistSq_postprocess_some
+    {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ} (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
+    {Sample Answer : Type*} [Fintype Answer] [DecidableEq Answer]
+    (law : Distribution Sample) (p1 p2 : Placement)
+    (first : Sample → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement Answer (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p1.side))
+    (second : Sample → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement Answer (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p2.side)) :
+    opFamilyDistSq law
+      (fun sample answer => S.place p1 (((first sample).postprocess some).effect answer))
+      (fun sample answer => S.place p2 (((second sample).postprocess some).effect answer))
+      S.psiHat =
+    opFamilyDistSq law (fun sample answer => S.place p1 ((first sample).effect answer))
+      (fun sample answer => S.place p2 ((second sample).effect answer)) S.psiHat := by
+  classical
+  unfold opFamilyDistSq
+  congr 1
+  funext sample
+  rw [Fintype.sum_option]
+  simp [MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess,
+    MIPStarRE.Quantum.Submeasurement.postprocess, Finset.sum_filter,
+    S.place_zero, applyOperatorToState]
+
+/-- The completed X marginal has the same `4 * δQ` bound on line-point
+samples. Source: the first comparison of `eq:pasting-q1`, paper
+`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:936-941`, before inserting the line. -/
+theorem CombinedPointsWitness.marginal_X_option_linePoint_distance_le
+    {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε δQ : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P ε}
+    (points : CombinedPointsWitness S δQ)
+    (p1 p2 : Placement) (hopp : p1.IsOpposite p2) :
+    opFamilyDistSq (Distribution.prod (linePointDist P.toLdParams)
+      (linePointDist P.toLdParams))
+      (fun sample answer => S.place p1
+        ((((points.Q p1.side sample.1.2 sample.2.2).postprocess Prod.fst).postprocess
+          some).effect answer))
+      (fun sample answer => S.place p2
+        ((S.pointMeasExpOption p2.side .X sample.1.2).effect answer))
+      S.psiHat ≤ 4 * δQ := by
+  unfold ProjectiveSetting.pointMeasExpOption
+  erw [S.opFamilyDistSq_postprocess_some]
+  exact points.marginal_X_linePoint_distance_le p1 p2 hopp
+
+/-- The completed Z marginal has the same `4 * δQ` bound on line-point
+samples. Source: the second comparison of `eq:pasting-q1`, paper
+`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:936-941`, before inserting the line. -/
+theorem CombinedPointsWitness.marginal_Z_option_linePoint_distance_le
+    {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε δQ : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P ε}
+    (points : CombinedPointsWitness S δQ)
+    (p1 p2 : Placement) (hopp : p1.IsOpposite p2) :
+    opFamilyDistSq (Distribution.prod (linePointDist P.toLdParams)
+      (linePointDist P.toLdParams))
+      (fun sample answer => S.place p1
+        ((((points.Q p1.side sample.1.2 sample.2.2).postprocess Prod.snd).postprocess
+          some).effect answer))
+      (fun sample answer => S.place p2
+        ((S.pointMeasExpOption p2.side .Z sample.2.2).effect answer))
+      S.psiHat ≤ 4 * δQ := by
+  unfold ProjectiveSetting.pointMeasExpOption
+  erw [S.opFamilyDistSq_postprocess_some]
+  exact points.marginal_Z_linePoint_distance_le p1 p2 hopp
+
+/-- On either placement the evaluated line is close to the completed point
+measurement. This formalization-only version of the intermediate comparison
+in `eq:pasting-q1` retains the strategy error. It follows from
+`lem:qld-comm-line-cons` item 3 and `lem:qld-comm-cons` item 1, rather than
+identifying measurements on different placements. -/
+theorem exists_expLine_point_same_placement_distance_le :
+    ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧
+      ∀ (P : AdmissibleParams) (ε : ℝ) (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
+        (p1 p2 : Placement), p1.IsOpposite p2 → ∀ W : PauliKind,
+        opFamilyDistSq (linePointDist P.toLdParams)
+          (fun sample answer => S.place p2
+            ((S.lineEvalMeasExp p2.side W sample.1 sample.2).effect answer))
+          (fun sample answer => S.place p2
+            ((S.pointMeasExpOption p2.side W sample.2).effect answer))
+          S.psiHat ≤ C * (ε + deltaLine ε) := by
+  obtain ⟨Cp, hCp, hp⟩ := expPoint_self_cons
+  obtain ⟨Cl, hCl, hl⟩ := expLine_point_cons'
+  refine ⟨2 * (Cp + Cl), by linarith, ?_⟩
+  intro P ε S p1 p2 hopp W
+  classical
+  have hreverse : p2.IsOpposite p1 := by
+    cases p1 <;> cases p2 <;> simp_all [Placement.IsOpposite]
+  have hpoint : opFamilyDistSq (linePointDist P.toLdParams)
+      (fun sample answer => S.place p1
+        ((S.pointMeasExpOption p1.side W sample.2).effect answer))
+      (fun sample answer => S.place p2
+        ((S.pointMeasExpOption p2.side W sample.2).effect answer)) S.psiHat ≤ Cp * ε := by
+    unfold ProjectiveSetting.pointMeasExpOption
+    erw [S.opFamilyDistSq_postprocess_some]
+    unfold opFamilyDistSq
+    rw [avgOver_linePointDist_point P.toLdParams (fun point =>
+      ∑ answer, ‖applyOperatorToState
+        (S.place p1 ((S.pointMeasExp p1.side W point).effect answer) -
+          S.place p2 ((S.pointMeasExp p2.side W point).effect answer)) S.psiHat‖ ^ 2)]
+    exact hp P ε S p1 p2 hopp W
+  have htri := opFamilyDistSq_le_of_le_of_le _ _ _ _ S.psiHat _ _
+    (hl P ε S p2 p1 hreverse W) hpoint
+  refine htri.trans ?_
+  have hε := S.eps_nonneg
+  have hline : 0 ≤ deltaLine ε := Real.sqrt_nonneg ε
+  nlinarith
+
+/-- Both genuine line--point marginal comparisons needed for pasting, in
+squared distance, follow from the supplied point witness and the expanded
+line comparisons. The `8 * δQ` term is not absorbed into the strategy error.
+Source: `eq:pasting-q1`, paper `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:936-941`. -/
+theorem exists_combinedPoints_line_marginal_distance_le :
+    ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧
+      ∀ (P : AdmissibleParams) (ε δQ : ℝ) (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
+        (points : CombinedPointsWitness S δQ)
+        (p1 p2 : Placement), p1.IsOpposite p2 →
+        opFamilyDistSq (Distribution.prod (linePointDist P.toLdParams)
+          (linePointDist P.toLdParams))
+          (fun sample answer => S.place p1
+            ((((points.Q p1.side sample.1.2 sample.2.2).postprocess Prod.fst).postprocess
+              some).effect answer))
+          (fun sample answer => S.place p2
+            ((S.lineEvalMeasExp p2.side .X sample.1.1 sample.1.2).effect answer))
+          S.psiHat ≤ 8 * δQ + C * (ε + deltaLine ε) ∧
+        opFamilyDistSq (Distribution.prod (linePointDist P.toLdParams)
+          (linePointDist P.toLdParams))
+          (fun sample answer => S.place p1
+            ((((points.Q p1.side sample.1.2 sample.2.2).postprocess Prod.snd).postprocess
+              some).effect answer))
+          (fun sample answer => S.place p2
+            ((S.lineEvalMeasExp p2.side .Z sample.2.1 sample.2.2).effect answer))
+          S.psiHat ≤ 8 * δQ + C * (ε + deltaLine ε) := by
+  obtain ⟨C, hC, hbound⟩ := exists_expLine_point_same_placement_distance_le
+  refine ⟨2 * C, by linarith, ?_⟩
+  intro P ε δQ S points p1 p2 hopp
+  classical
+  have hX : opFamilyDistSq (Distribution.prod (linePointDist P.toLdParams)
+      (linePointDist P.toLdParams))
+      (fun sample answer => S.place p2
+        ((S.pointMeasExpOption p2.side .X sample.1.2).effect answer))
+      (fun sample answer => S.place p2
+        ((S.lineEvalMeasExp p2.side .X sample.1.1 sample.1.2).effect answer))
+      S.psiHat ≤ C * (ε + deltaLine ε) := by
+    rw [DistanceCalculus.opFamilyDistSq_symm]
+    unfold opFamilyDistSq
+    rw [avgOver_prod]
+    simp_rw [avgOver_const_of_isProbability _ (linePointDist_isProbability P.toLdParams)]
+    exact hbound P ε S p1 p2 hopp .X
+  have hZ : opFamilyDistSq (Distribution.prod (linePointDist P.toLdParams)
+      (linePointDist P.toLdParams))
+      (fun sample answer => S.place p2
+        ((S.pointMeasExpOption p2.side .Z sample.2.2).effect answer))
+      (fun sample answer => S.place p2
+        ((S.lineEvalMeasExp p2.side .Z sample.2.1 sample.2.2).effect answer))
+      S.psiHat ≤ C * (ε + deltaLine ε) := by
+    rw [DistanceCalculus.opFamilyDistSq_symm]
+    unfold opFamilyDistSq
+    rw [avgOver_prod]
+    erw [avgOver_const_of_isProbability _ (linePointDist_isProbability P.toLdParams)
+      (opFamilyDistSq (linePointDist P.toLdParams)
+        (fun sample answer => S.place p2
+          ((S.lineEvalMeasExp p2.side .Z sample.1 sample.2).effect answer))
+        (fun sample answer => S.place p2
+          ((S.pointMeasExpOption p2.side .Z sample.2).effect answer)) S.psiHat)]
+    exact hbound P ε S p1 p2 hopp .Z
+  constructor
+  · convert opFamilyDistSq_le_of_le_of_le _ _ _ _ S.psiHat _ _
+      (points.marginal_X_option_linePoint_distance_le p1 p2 hopp) hX using 1
+    ring
+  · convert opFamilyDistSq_le_of_le_of_le _ _ _ _ S.psiHat _ _
+      (points.marginal_Z_option_linePoint_distance_le p1 p2 hopp) hZ using 1
+    ring
+
+/-- Completing a joint answer and then taking its X marginal agrees with
+completing the X marginal. This is a formalization-only postprocessing
+identity for `eq:pasting-q1`; it is not an extra marginal hypothesis. -/
+theorem CombinedPointsWitness.completed_fst_effect
+    {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε δQ : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P ε}
+    (points : CombinedPointsWitness S δQ) (side : PlayerSide)
+    (x z : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) (answer : Option (PauliScalar P)) :
+    (((points.Q side x z).postprocess (fun pair => (some pair.1, some pair.2))).postprocess
+      Prod.fst).effect answer =
+      (((points.Q side x z).postprocess Prod.fst).postprocess some).effect answer := by
+  classical
+  exact congrArg (fun meas => meas.effect answer)
+    ((MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_comp (points.Q side x z)
+      (fun pair => (some pair.1, some pair.2)) Prod.fst).trans
+      (MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_comp (points.Q side x z) Prod.fst some).symm)
+
+/-- Completing a joint answer and then taking its Z marginal agrees with
+completing the Z marginal. Source: `eq:pasting-q1`, with the existing
+completed evaluation convention. -/
+theorem CombinedPointsWitness.completed_snd_effect
+    {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε δQ : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P ε}
+    (points : CombinedPointsWitness S δQ) (side : PlayerSide)
+    (x z : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) (answer : Option (PauliScalar P)) :
+    (((points.Q side x z).postprocess (fun pair => (some pair.1, some pair.2))).postprocess
+      Prod.snd).effect answer =
+      (((points.Q side x z).postprocess Prod.snd).postprocess some).effect answer := by
+  classical
+  exact congrArg (fun meas => meas.effect answer)
+    ((MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_comp (points.Q side x z)
+      (fun pair => (some pair.1, some pair.2)) Prod.snd).trans
+      (MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_comp (points.Q side x z) Prod.snd some).symm)
+
+/-- The two forward marginal hypotheses for pasting hold in the consistency
+convention, with explicit dependence on both errors. Source: `eq:pasting-q1`,
+paper `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:936-941`. Projectivity is
+derived from the existing measurements and their postprocessings. -/
+theorem exists_combinedPoints_line_marginal_defect_le :
+    ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧
+      ∀ (P : AdmissibleParams) (ε δQ : ℝ) (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
+        (points : CombinedPointsWitness S δQ)
+        (p1 p2 : Placement), p1.IsOpposite p2 →
+        consistencyDefect (Distribution.prod (linePointDist P.toLdParams)
+          (linePointDist P.toLdParams))
+          (fun sample answer => S.place p1
+            ((((points.Q p1.side sample.1.2 sample.2.2).postprocess
+              (fun pair => (some pair.1, some pair.2))).postprocess Prod.fst).effect answer))
+          (fun sample answer => S.place p2
+            ((S.lineEvalMeasExp p2.side .X sample.1.1 sample.1.2).effect answer))
+          S.psiHat ≤ 8 * δQ + C * (ε + deltaLine ε) ∧
+        consistencyDefect (Distribution.prod (linePointDist P.toLdParams)
+          (linePointDist P.toLdParams))
+          (fun sample answer => S.place p1
+            ((((points.Q p1.side sample.1.2 sample.2.2).postprocess
+              (fun pair => (some pair.1, some pair.2))).postprocess Prod.snd).effect answer))
+          (fun sample answer => S.place p2
+            ((S.lineEvalMeasExp p2.side .Z sample.2.1 sample.2.2).effect answer))
+          S.psiHat ≤ 8 * δQ + C * (ε + deltaLine ε) := by
+  obtain ⟨C, hC, hbound⟩ := exists_combinedPoints_line_marginal_distance_le
+  refine ⟨C, hC, ?_⟩
+  intro P ε δQ S points p1 p2 hopp
+  classical
+  simp_rw [points.completed_fst_effect, points.completed_snd_effect]
+  have hcompare (coordinate : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P → PauliScalar P)
+      (sampleLine : (LineDesc P.toLdParams × (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) ×
+        (LineDesc P.toLdParams × (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) →
+        LineDesc P.toLdParams × (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (W : PauliKind) :=
+    consistencyDefect_le_opFamilyDistSq_of_projective
+      (Distribution.prod (linePointDist P.toLdParams) (linePointDist P.toLdParams))
+      (fun sample => S.placedMeasurement p1
+        (((points.Q p1.side sample.1.2 sample.2.2).postprocess coordinate).postprocess some))
+      (fun sample => S.placedMeasurement p2
+        (S.lineEvalMeasExp p2.side W (sampleLine sample).1 (sampleLine sample).2)) S.psiHat
+      (fun sample => S.placedMeasurement_isProjective p1 _
+        (SandwichProduct.postprocess_isProjective _
+          (SandwichProduct.postprocess_isProjective _ (points.projective _ _ _) _) _))
+      (fun sample => S.placedMeasurement_isProjective p2 _
+        (SandwichProduct.postprocess_isProjective _ (S.lineMeasExp_isProjective _ _ _) _))
+  exact ⟨(hcompare Prod.fst Prod.fst .X).trans (hbound P ε δQ S points p1 p2 hopp).1,
+    (hcompare Prod.snd Prod.snd .Z).trans (hbound P ε δQ S points p1 p2 hopp).2⟩
+
+
+end

+import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Combining.Lines.DiagonalResampling
+import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Combining.Lines.SubLineMixture
+import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Combining.Points
+import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Combining.Lines.PointwiseDefect
+import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Combining.Lines.WeightedCollision
+import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Combining.Lines.ZeroDirectionMass
+import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Games.RestrictedAverage
+
+/-!
+# Sampling for conditioned line pasting
+
+The sampling identities retain the zero-direction mass when restoring the
+original line-point law.
+
+## References
+
+Paper `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:882-963`,
+blueprint `lem:qld-xz-lines`. The source and completed-answer distinctions are
+documented in `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_combined-lines-error-term.tex`.
+-/
+
+namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
+
+open MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
+open MIPStarRE.Quantum MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus
+open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder
+
+noncomputable section
+
+/-- Under the unchanged diagonal line-point law, zero projected directions have
+probability at most the inverse field size: the last sampled direction coordinate must
+vanish and is uniform. Source: `def:line-point-dist`, paper
+`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:274-287`. This proof-only bound
+supports the collision restriction in issue #118. -/
+theorem dLinePointDist_zero_direction_mass_le (L : LdParams) :
+    avgOver (dLinePointDist L) (fun sample =>
+      if sample.1.direction = 0 then 1 else 0) ≤
+      1 / Fintype.card (ScalarQ L) := by
+  classical
+  let last : Fin L.m := ⟨L.m - 1, by have := L.hm; omega⟩
+  let coord : LdIndex L := .inr last
+  have hmap : (uniformDistribution (LdSpace L)).map (fun raw => raw coord) =
+      uniformDistribution (ScalarQ L) := by
+    change (uniformDistribution (LdSpace L)).map
+      (fun raw => (Equiv.funSplitAt coord (ScalarQ L) raw).1) = _
+    rw [← Distribution.map_map, uniformDistribution_map_equiv,
+      uniformDistribution_map_fst]
+  have hzero : avgOver (uniformDistribution (LdSpace L))
+      (fun raw => if raw coord = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
+      1 / Fintype.card (ScalarQ L) := by
+    rw [← Distribution.avgOver_map (uniformDistribution (LdSpace L))
+      (fun raw => raw coord) (fun value => if value = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0), hmap]
+    simp [avgOver, uniformDistribution_weight_apply, mul_ite]
+  unfold dLinePointDist clDistribution
+  rw [Distribution.avgOver_map, Distribution.avgOver_map]
+  refine le_trans (avgOver_mono _ _ _ ?_) hzero.le
+  intro raw
+  dsimp only
+  rw [dLineDescOf_ldDLineCL]
+  split_ifs with hdir hcoord hcoord
+  · exact le_rfl
+  · exfalso
+    apply hcoord
+    have hlast := congrFun hdir last
+    change prefixProjection (chiIndex L (LdSpace.seed raw))
+      (LdSpace.direction raw) last = 0 at hlast
+    have hindex : ¬ last.val < (chiIndex L (LdSpace.seed raw)).val := by
+      have := (chiIndex L (LdSpace.seed raw)).isLt
+      dsimp [last]
+      omega
+    simpa [prefixProjection, hindex, LdSpace.direction, coord] using hlast
+  · norm_num
+  · exact le_rfl
+
+/-- The equal mixture of axis and diagonal line-point laws gives zero directions
+mass at most `1 / (2q)`. This proof-only estimate preserves the source sampler of
+`def:line-point-dist`, paper `08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:274-287`,
+including its degenerate fibers. -/
+theorem linePointDist_zero_direction_mass_le (L : LdParams) :
+    avgOver (linePointDist L) (fun sample =>
+      if sample.1.direction = 0 then 1 else 0) ≤
+      1 / (2 * Fintype.card (ScalarQ L)) := by
+  rw [linePointDist, avgOver_mix, aLinePointDist_zero_direction_mass]
+  have hdiag := dLinePointDist_zero_direction_mass_le L
+  calc
+    _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * avgOver (dLinePointDist L)
+        (fun sample => if sample.1.direction = 0 then 1 else 0) := by ring
+    _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (1 / Fintype.card (ScalarQ L)) :=
+      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdiag (by norm_num)
+    _ = _ := by rw [one_div_mul_one_div]
+
+/-- A uniform point may be replaced by a uniform affine parameter on its
+canonical line, while preserving the canonical representative jointly with the
+point. This formalization-only identity, including zero directions, supports the
+conditional sampling step at paper `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:955`. -/
+theorem avgOver_lineRepMap_resample_parameter {K : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
+    {dimension : ℕ} (direction : Fin dimension → K)
+    (value : (Fin dimension → K) → (Fin dimension → K) → ℝ) :
+    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin dimension → K))
+      (fun point => value (lineRepMap direction point) point) =
+    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin dimension → K)) (fun point =>
+      avgOver (uniformDistribution K) (fun param =>
+        value (lineRepMap direction point) (lineRepMap direction point + param • direction))) := by
+  have hmap := uniformDistribution_map_lineRepMap_add_smul direction
+  have havg := congrArg (fun dist => avgOver dist
+    (fun point => value (lineRepMap direction point) point)) hmap
+  rw [Distribution.avgOver_map, uniformDistribution_prod, avgOver_prod] at havg
+  simpa only [lineRepMap_add_smul, lineRepMap_apply_self] using havg.symm
+
+/-- Nondegenerate line fibers have total mass at least three quarters in the
+unchanged line-point law. This follows from the zero-direction mass bound and
+the fact that a field has at least two elements. This proof-only positivity bound
+supports conditioning at paper `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:950-963`. -/
+theorem linePointDist_nondegenerate_mass_ge (L : LdParams) :
+    (3 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ ∑ sample ∈ (linePointDist L).support.filter
+      (fun sample => sample.1.direction ≠ 0), (linePointDist L).weight sample := by
+  classical
+  have hsplit : (∑ sample ∈ (linePointDist L).support.filter
+        (fun sample => sample.1.direction ≠ 0), (linePointDist L).weight sample) +
+      avgOver (linePointDist L) (fun sample => if sample.1.direction = 0 then 1 else 0) = 1 := by
+    simp only [avgOver, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, ← Finset.sum_filter]
+    rw [add_comm, Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not]
+    exact (linePointDist_isProbability L).weight_sum_eq_one
+  have hmass := linePointDist_zero_direction_mass_le L
+  have hcard : (2 : ℝ) ≤ Fintype.card (ScalarQ L) := by
+    exact_mod_cast Fintype.one_lt_card (α := ScalarQ L)
+  have hquarter : 1 / (2 * (Fintype.card (ScalarQ L) : ℝ)) ≤ 1 / 4 := by
+    apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num)
+    linarith
+  linarith
+
+/-- For two independent line-point samples, excluding only zero X directions
+costs at most `1 / (2q)`. Only X requires the collision estimate when the
+X-outer sandwich is instantiated with `G2 = X`. This is a proof-only bound for
+paper `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:943-963`. -/
+theorem prod_linePointDist_zero_X_direction_mass_le (L : LdParams) :
+    avgOver (Distribution.prod (linePointDist L) (linePointDist L))
+      (fun samples => if samples.1.1.direction = 0 then 1 else 0) ≤
+      1 / (2 * Fintype.card (ScalarQ L)) := by
+  rw [avgOver_prod]
+  change avgOver (linePointDist L) (fun sample => avgOver (linePointDist L)
+    (fun _ => if sample.1.direction = 0 then 1 else 0)) ≤ _
+  simp_rw [avgOver_const_of_isProbability _ (linePointDist_isProbability L)]
+  exact linePointDist_zero_direction_mass_le L
+
+
+end
+
+end MIPStarRE.QPBT

   229	fixed unit basis vectors. Tensor placement preserves the measurements and their
   230	projectivity; `Pasting.consistencyDefect_productPaddedState` preserves the input
   231	and output defects. The unit state internally excludes empty local carriers;
   232	no nonemptiness assumption on outcomes is needed. See issue #495 and blueprint
   233	`lem:pasting-heterogeneous`.
   234	
   235	**Local fix:** the additive interpretation of `IsPolyErr₂` is documented in
   236	`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_pasting-product-error.tex`, issue #201. -/
   237	theorem exists_pasting_error_heterogeneous :
   238	    ∃ δp : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, IsPolyErr₂ δp ∧
   239	      ∀ {X Y₁ Y₂ R₁ R₂ Γ₁ Γ₂ ιA ιB : Type*}
   240	        [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype Y₁] [DecidableEq Y₁]
   241	        [Fintype Y₂] [DecidableEq Y₂] [Fintype R₁] [DecidableEq R₁]
   242	        [Fintype R₂] [DecidableEq R₂]
   243	        [Fintype Γ₁] [DecidableEq Γ₁] [Fintype Γ₂] [DecidableEq Γ₂]
   244	        [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
   245	        (D : Distribution ((X × Y₁) × Y₂))
   246	        (eval₁ : Γ₁ → Y₁ → R₁) (eval₂ : Γ₂ → Y₂ → R₂)
   247	        (G₁ : X → Measurement Γ₁ ιB) (G₂ : X → Measurement Γ₂ ιB)
   248	        (A : ((X × Y₁) × Y₂) → Measurement (R₁ × R₂) ιA)
   249	        (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (η δ : ℝ),
   250	        D.IsProbability → ‖ψ‖ = 1 → 0 ≤ η → 0 ≤ δ →
   251	        (∀ x, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (G₂ x)) →
   252	        (∀ q, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (A q)) →
   253	        HasConditionalCollisionBound D eval₂ η →
   254	        consistencyDefect D
   255	          (fun q a₁ => heteroKron (((A q).postprocess Prod.fst).effect a₁) 1)
   256	          (fun q a₁ => heteroKron 1 (((G₁ q.1.1).postprocess
   257	            (fun g => eval₁ g q.1.2)).effect a₁)) ψ ≤ δ →
   258	        consistencyDefect D
   259	          (fun q a₂ => heteroKron (((A q).postprocess Prod.snd).effect a₂) 1)
   260	          (fun q a₂ => heteroKron 1 (((G₂ q.1.1).postprocess
   261	            (fun g => eval₂ g q.2)).effect a₂)) ψ ≤ δ →
   262	        consistencyDefect D (fun q a => heteroKron ((A q).effect a) 1)
   263	          (fun q a => heteroKron 1 (∑ g₁ : Γ₁, ∑ g₂ : Γ₂,
   264	            if (eval₁ g₁ q.1.2, eval₂ g₂ q.2) = a then
   265	              pastedMeasurement (fun g => (G₁ q.1.1).effect g)
   266	                (fun g => (G₂ q.1.1).effect g) g₁ g₂ else 0)) ψ ≤ δp η δ := by
   267	  classical
   268	  obtain ⟨δp, hpoly, hbound⟩ := exists_pasting_error_of_marginal_consistency
   269	  refine ⟨δp, hpoly, ?_⟩
   270	  intro X Y₁ Y₂ R₁ R₂ Γ₁ Γ₂ ιA ιB _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
   271	    D eval₁ eval₂ G₁ G₂ A ψ η δ hD hψ hη hδ hG₂ hA hcoll h₁ h₂
   272	  have hnonempty : Nonempty (ιA × ιB) := by
   273	    rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty (ιA × ιB) with h | h
   274	    · letI := h
   275	      have hz : ψ = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
   276	      simp [hz] at hψ
   277	    · exact h
   278	  obtain ⟨⟨a₀, b₀⟩⟩ := hnonempty
   279	  let A' := fun q => Measurement.leftPlacement (ιB := ιB) (A q)
   280	  let G₁' := fun x => Measurement.rightPlacement (ιA := ιA) (G₁ x)
   281	  let G₂' := fun x => Measurement.rightPlacement (ιA := ιA) (G₂ x)
   282	  let ψ' := Pasting.productPaddedState a₀ b₀ ψ
   283	  have hψ' : ‖ψ'‖ = 1 := (Pasting.productPaddedState_norm a₀ b₀ ψ).trans hψ
   284	  have h₁' : consistencyDefect D
   285	      (fun q a₁ => heteroKron (((A' q).postprocess Prod.fst).effect a₁) 1)
   286	      (fun q a₁ => heteroKron 1 (((G₁' q.1.1).postprocess
   287	        (fun g => eval₁ g q.1.2)).effect a₁)) ψ' ≤ δ := by
   288	    simpa only [A', G₁', ψ', ← Measurement.leftPlacement_postprocess,
   289	      ← Measurement.rightPlacement_postprocess, Measurement.leftPlacement_effect,
   290	      Measurement.rightPlacement_effect, Pasting.consistencyDefect_productPaddedState] using h₁
   291	  have h₂' : consistencyDefect D
   292	      (fun q a₂ => heteroKron (((A' q).postprocess Prod.snd).effect a₂) 1)
   293	      (fun q a₂ => heteroKron 1 (((G₂' q.1.1).postprocess
   294	        (fun g => eval₂ g q.2)).effect a₂)) ψ' ≤ δ := by
   295	    simpa only [A', G₂', ψ', ← Measurement.leftPlacement_postprocess,
   296	      ← Measurement.rightPlacement_postprocess, Measurement.leftPlacement_effect,
   297	      Measurement.rightPlacement_effect, Pasting.consistencyDefect_productPaddedState] using h₂
   298	  have hpadded := hbound D eval₁ eval₂ G₁' G₂' A' ψ' η δ hD hψ' hη hδ
   299	    (fun x => Measurement.isProjective_rightPlacement (G₂ x) (hG₂ x))
   300	    (fun q => Measurement.isProjective_leftPlacement (A q) (hA q)) hcoll h₁' h₂'
   301	  have hpaste (q : (X × Y₁) × Y₂) (a : R₁ × R₂) :
   302	      (∑ g₁ : Γ₁, ∑ g₂ : Γ₂,
   303	        if (eval₁ g₁ q.1.2, eval₂ g₂ q.2) = a then
   304	          pastedMeasurement (fun g => (G₁' q.1.1).effect g)
   305	            (fun g => (G₂' q.1.1).effect g) g₁ g₂ else 0) =
   306	        heteroKron (1 : Op ιA) (∑ g₁ : Γ₁, ∑ g₂ : Γ₂,
   307	          if (eval₁ g₁ q.1.2, eval₂ g₂ q.2) = a then
   308	            pastedMeasurement (fun g => (G₁ q.1.1).effect g)
   309	              (fun g => (G₂ q.1.1).effect g) g₁ g₂ else 0) := by
   310	    simp only [G₁', G₂', Measurement.rightPlacement_effect, pastedMeasurement,
   311	      heteroKron_mul, one_mul]
   312	    simp_rw [heteroKron_finset_sum_right]
   313	    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   314	    intro g₁ _
   315	    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   316	    intro g₂ _
   317	    split_ifs <;> simp [heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker]
   318	  simp_rw [hpaste] at hpadded
   319	  simpa only [A', ψ', Measurement.leftPlacement_effect,
   320	    Pasting.consistencyDefect_productPaddedState] using hpadded
   321	
   322	end MIPStarRE.QPBT

     4	/-!
     5	# Retained mass for nondegenerate-line pasting
     6	
     7	This module defines the mass retained when the first line in the product
     8	line-point law is restricted to nonzero direction and proves uniform lower and
     9	upper bounds for that mass.
    10	
    11	## References
    12	
    13	The restriction is the proof-only conditioning used in `lem:qld-xz-lines`,
    14	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:950-963`.
    15	-/
    16	
    17	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    18	
    19	open MIPStarRE.LDT
    20	
    21	noncomputable section
    22	
    23	/-- Probability retained by the proof-only first-line nondegeneracy
    24	restriction in the pasting argument for `lem:qld-xz-lines`. -/
    25	def nondegenerateLinePastingMass (L : LdParams) : ℝ :=
    26	  ∑ samples ∈
    27	      (Distribution.prod (linePointDist L) (linePointDist L)).support.filter
    28	        (fun samples => samples.1.1.direction ≠ 0),
    29	    (Distribution.prod (linePointDist L) (linePointDist L)).weight samples
    30	
    31	/-- The retained product-law mass lies between one half and one. -/
    32	theorem nondegenerateLinePastingMass_bounds (L : LdParams) :
    33	    1 / 2 ≤ nondegenerateLinePastingMass L ∧
    34	      nondegenerateLinePastingMass L ≤ 1 := by
    35	  classical
    36	  let indicator := fun sample : LineDesc L × (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L) =>
    37	    if sample.1.direction ≠ 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0
    38	  have hmass : nondegenerateLinePastingMass L =
    39	      avgOver (linePointDist L) indicator := by
    40	    unfold nondegenerateLinePastingMass
    41	    rw [Distribution.sum_filter_weight_eq_avgOver, avgOver_prod]
    42	    change avgOver (linePointDist L) (fun sample =>
    43	      avgOver (linePointDist L) (fun _ => indicator sample)) = _
    44	    simp_rw [avgOver_const_of_isProbability _ (linePointDist_isProbability L)]
    45	  have haxis : avgOver (aLinePointDist L) indicator = 1 := by
    46	    have hindicator : indicator = fun sample =>
    47	        1 - if sample.1.direction = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0 := by
    48	      funext sample
    49	      by_cases hzero : sample.1.direction = 0 <;> simp [indicator, hzero]
    50	    rw [hindicator, avgOver_sub,
    51	      avgOver_const_of_isProbability _ (aLinePointDist_isProbability L),
    52	      aLinePointDist_zero_direction_mass]
    53	    norm_num
    54	  have hdiag : 0 ≤ avgOver (dLinePointDist L) indicator :=
    55	    avgOver_nonneg _ _ fun sample => by
    56	      by_cases hzero : sample.1.direction = 0 <;> simp [indicator, hzero]
    57	  have hlower : 1 / 2 ≤ avgOver (linePointDist L) indicator := by
    58	    rw [linePointDist, avgOver_mix, haxis]
    59	    norm_num
    60	    linarith
    61	  rw [hmass]
    62	  refine ⟨hlower, ?_⟩
    63	  calc
    64	    avgOver (linePointDist L) indicator ≤
    65	      avgOver (linePointDist L) (fun _ => 1) :=
    66	      avgOver_mono _ _ _ fun sample => by
    67	        by_cases hzero : sample.1.direction = 0 <;> simp [indicator, hzero]
    68	    _ = 1 := avgOver_const_of_isProbability _ (linePointDist_isProbability L) 1
    69	
    70	end
    71	
    72	end MIPStarRE.QPBT

     3	/-!
     4	# Zero-direction mass for axis lines
     5	
     6	This module records that the axis-line component of the line-point sampler has
     7	no mass at zero direction.
     8	
     9	## References
    10	
    11	The sampler is `def:line-point-dist`, from
    12	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:274-287`.
    13	-/
    14	
    15	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    16	
    17	open MIPStarRE.LDT
    18	
    19	noncomputable section
    20	
    21	/-- Axis-line sampling gives zero mass to zero directions, since a coordinate
    22	direction is nonzero. This is a formalization-only consequence of
    23	`def:line-point-dist`, paper `08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:274-287`. -/
    24	theorem aLinePointDist_zero_direction_mass (L : LdParams) :
    25	    avgOver (aLinePointDist L) (fun sample =>
    26	      if sample.1.direction = 0 then 1 else 0) = 0 := by
    27	  classical
    28	  unfold aLinePointDist
    29	  rw [Distribution.avgOver_map]
    30	  have hdir (raw : LdSpace L) : (aLineDescOf L raw).direction ≠ 0 := by
    31	    intro hzero
    32	    have hcoord := congrFun hzero (chiIndex L raw.seed)
    33	    simp [aLineDescOf, LineDesc.direction, coordinateDirection] at hcoord
    34	  simp [avgOver, hdir]
    35	
    36	end

     3	
     4	/-!
     5	# Weighted collision bounds for sampled lines
     6	
     7	This module lifts the uniform affine-parameter collision estimate to the mixed
     8	line-point distribution with an arbitrary nonnegative weight depending only on
     9	the sampled line.
    10	
    11	## References
    12	
    13	The estimate is the Schwartz--Zippel step in `lem:qld-xz-lines`,
    14	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:950-955`.
    15	-/
    16	
    17	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    18	
    19	open MIPStarRE.LDT
    20	
    21	noncomputable section
    22	
    23	/-- The collision bound remains valid with any nonnegative weight depending
    24	only on the line, after restricting to nonzero directions. This proof-only
    25	estimate is the conditional form of the root argument in `lem:qld-xz-lines`,
    26	paper lines 950--955; it does not assert the false unrestricted collision bound
    27	on zero-direction coefficient presentations. -/
    28	theorem linePointDist_nondegenerate_weighted_collision_le {L : LdParams}
    29	    {bound : ℕ} (weight : LineDesc L → ℝ)
    30	    (hweight : ∀ line, 0 ≤ weight line) (first second : DegPoly L bound)
    31	    (hne : first ≠ second) :
    32	    avgOver (linePointDist L) (fun sample =>
    33	      if sample.1.direction ≠ 0 then weight sample.1 *
    34	        (if evalOpt sample.1 sample.2 first = evalOpt sample.1 sample.2 second
    35	          then 1 else 0) else 0) ≤
    36	      (bound : ℝ) / Fintype.card (ScalarQ L) *
    37	        avgOver (linePointDist L) (fun sample =>
    38	          if sample.1.direction ≠ 0 then weight sample.1 else 0) := by
    39	  classical
    40	  rw [avgOver_linePointDist_resample_parameter]
    41	  rw [← avgOver_const_mul]
    42	  apply avgOver_mono
    43	  intro sample
    44	  by_cases hdir : sample.1.direction ≠ 0
    45	  · simp only [if_pos hdir]
    46	    rw [avgOver_const_mul]
    47	    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    48	      (evalOpt_uniform_parameter_collision_le sample.1 hdir first second hne)
    49	      (hweight sample.1)).trans_eq
    50	      (mul_comm _ _)
    51	  · simp [hdir, avgOver]
    52	
    53	end
    54	
    55	end MIPStarRE.QPBT

    11	-/
    12	
    13	open scoped BigOperators
    14	
    15	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    16	
    17	open MIPStarRE.LDT MIPStarRE.Quantum
    18	
    19	/-- The off-diagonal defect in blueprint
    20	`def:consistency`, paper `06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:232-248`. -/
    21	noncomputable def consistencyDefect {X α ι : Type*}
    22	    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    23	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    24	    (μ : Distribution X) (A B : X → α → Op ι)
    25	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) : ℝ :=
    26	  avgOver μ (fun x =>
    27	    ∑ a : α, ∑ b : α,
    28	      if a = b then 0 else
    29	        (inner ℂ ψ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv ι ℂ).symm
    30	          ((A x a * B x b).mulVec ψ))).re)
    31	
    32	/-- A uniform consistency defect is invariant under a bijective relabeling of
    33	its question type. -/
    34	theorem consistencyDefect_uniform_question_equiv
    35	    {X Y Outcome iota : Type*}
    36	    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Nonempty X]
    37	    [Fintype Y] [DecidableEq Y] [Nonempty Y]
    38	    [Fintype Outcome] [DecidableEq Outcome]
    39	    [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    40	    (e : X ≃ Y) (A B : Y → Outcome → Op iota)
    41	    (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ iota) :
    42	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution X)
    43	        (fun x a => A (e x) a) (fun x a => B (e x) a) psi =
    44	      consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution Y) A B psi := by
    45	  unfold consistencyDefect
    46	  simpa using avgOver_uniform_equiv e (fun x =>
    47	    ∑ a : Outcome, ∑ b : Outcome,
    48	      if a = b then 0 else
    49	        (inner ℂ psi ((EuclideanSpace.equiv iota ℂ).symm
    50	          (((A (e x) a) * (B (e x) b)).mulVec psi))).re)
    51	
    52	/-- A consistency defect is invariant under a bijective relabeling of both
    53	outcome families. -/
    54	theorem consistencyDefect_outcome_equiv
    55	    {X Alpha Beta iota : Type*}
    56	    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]
    57	    [Fintype Alpha] [DecidableEq Alpha]
    58	    [Fintype Beta] [DecidableEq Beta]
    59	    [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    60	    (mu : Distribution X) (e : Beta ≃ Alpha)
    61	    (A B : X → Alpha → Op iota) (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ iota) :
    62	    consistencyDefect mu
    63	        (fun x b => A x (e b)) (fun x b => B x (e b)) psi =
    64	      consistencyDefect mu A B psi := by
    65	  unfold consistencyDefect
    66	  apply avgOver_congr
    67	  intro x
    68	  let term : Alpha → Alpha → ℝ := fun a b =>
    69	    if a = b then 0 else
    70	      (inner ℂ psi ((EuclideanSpace.equiv iota ℂ).symm
    71	        (((A x a) * (B x b)).mulVec psi))).re
    72	  calc
    73	    _ = ∑ a : Beta, ∑ b : Beta, term (e a) (e b) := by
    74	      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    75	      intro a _
    76	      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    77	      intro b _
    78	      unfold term
    79	      by_cases hab : a = b
    80	      · subst b
    81	        simp
    82	      · have heab : e a ≠ e b := fun h => hab (e.injective h)
    83	        simp [hab, heab]
    84	    _ =
    85	        ∑ a : Beta, ∑ b : Alpha, term (e a) b := by
    86	      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    87	      intro a _
    88	      exact Equiv.sum_comp e (fun b => term (e a) b)
    89	    _ = ∑ a : Alpha, ∑ b : Alpha, term a b :=
    90	      Equiv.sum_comp e (fun a => ∑ b : Alpha, term a b)
    91	    _ = _ := rfl

    93	/-- Simultaneous bijective relabeling of uniform questions and outcomes leaves
    94	the consistency defect unchanged. -/
    95	theorem consistencyDefect_uniform_question_outcome_equiv
    96	    {X Y Alpha Beta iota : Type*}
    97	    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Nonempty X]
    98	    [Fintype Y] [DecidableEq Y] [Nonempty Y]
    99	    [Fintype Alpha] [DecidableEq Alpha]
   100	    [Fintype Beta] [DecidableEq Beta]
   101	    [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   102	    (questionEquiv : X ≃ Y) (outcomeEquiv : Beta ≃ Alpha)
   103	    (A B : Y → Alpha → Op iota) (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ iota) :
   104	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution X)
   105	        (fun x b => A (questionEquiv x) (outcomeEquiv b))
   106	        (fun x b => B (questionEquiv x) (outcomeEquiv b)) psi =
   107	      consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution Y) A B psi := by
   108	  calc
   109	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution X)
   110	        (fun x b => A (questionEquiv x) (outcomeEquiv b))
   111	        (fun x b => B (questionEquiv x) (outcomeEquiv b)) psi =
   112	      consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution X)
   113	        (fun x a => A (questionEquiv x) a)
   114	        (fun x a => B (questionEquiv x) a) psi :=
   115	      consistencyDefect_outcome_equiv (uniformDistribution X)
   116	        outcomeEquiv _ _ psi
   117	    _ = consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution Y) A B psi :=
   118	      consistencyDefect_uniform_question_equiv questionEquiv A B psi

   120	/-- Pointwise equality of both operator families gives equality of their
   121	consistency defects. -/
   122	theorem consistencyDefect_congr
   123	    {X Outcome iota : Type*}
   124	    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]
   125	    [Fintype Outcome] [DecidableEq Outcome]
   126	    [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   127	    (mu : Distribution X) (A A' B B' : X → Outcome → Op iota)
   128	    (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ iota)
   129	    (hA : ∀ x a, A x a = A' x a) (hB : ∀ x a, B x a = B' x a) :
   130	    consistencyDefect mu A B psi = consistencyDefect mu A' B' psi := by
   131	  unfold consistencyDefect
   132	  apply avgOver_congr
   133	  intro x
   134	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   135	  intro a _
   136	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   137	  intro b _
   138	  by_cases hab : a = b
   139	  · simp [hab]
   140	  · simp only [hab, if_false]
   141	    rw [hA x a, hB x b]

   143	/-- The quantitative relation in blueprint
   144	`def:consistency`, paper `06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:232-248`. -/
   145	def IsConsistentWithin {X α ι : Type*}
   146	    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   147	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   148	    (μ : Distribution X) (A B : X → α → Op ι)
   149	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (δ : ℝ) : Prop :=
   150	  consistencyDefect μ A B ψ ≤ δ

   152	/-- Unit-alphabet specialization of blueprint
   153	`def:povm-distance`, paper `06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:258-271`. -/
   154	noncomputable def opDistSq {X ι : Type*}
   155	    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   156	    (μ : Distribution X) (M N : X → Op ι) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) : ℝ :=
   157	  opFamilyDistSq μ (fun x (_ : Unit) => M x) (fun x (_ : Unit) => N x) ψ
   158	
   159	/-- The unit-alphabet operator distance equals its one-outcome family form from
   160	blueprint `def:povm-distance`, paper
   161	`06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:258-271`. -/
   162	theorem opDistSq_eq_opFamilyDistSq {X ι : Type*}
   163	    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   164	    (μ : Distribution X) (M N : X → Op ι) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   165	    opDistSq μ M N ψ = opFamilyDistSq μ (fun x (_ : Unit) => M x)
   166	      (fun x (_ : Unit) => N x) ψ := rfl

   168	/-- The strategy-distance relation `def:strategy-distance`. The two strategies'
   169	local Hilbert spaces are identified, and both measurement distances are
   170	evaluated on the first strategy's state. Blueprint
   171	`def:strategy-distance`, paper `06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:273-285`. -/
   172	structure AreCloseStrategies (G : Game) (S S' : Strategy G) (δ : ℝ) : Prop where
   173	  /-- Identification of Alice's local Hilbert spaces. -/
   174	  hA : S.ιA = S'.ιA
   175	  /-- Identification of Bob's local Hilbert spaces. -/
   176	  hB : S.ιB = S'.ιB
   177	  state : stateDistSq S.ψ (reindexState
   178	      (Equiv.prodCongr (Equiv.cast hA).symm (Equiv.cast hB).symm) S'.ψ) ≤ δ
   179	  alice : opFamilyDistSq (G.μ.map Prod.fst)
   180	      (fun x a => heteroKron ((S.A x).effect a) 1)
   181	      (fun x a => heteroKron (reindexOp (Equiv.cast hA) ((S'.A x).effect a)) 1)
   182	      S.ψ ≤ δ
   183	  bob : opFamilyDistSq (G.μ.map Prod.snd)
   184	      (fun y b => heteroKron 1 ((S.B y).effect b))
   185	      (fun y b => heteroKron 1 (reindexOp (Equiv.cast hB) ((S'.B y).effect b)))
   186	      S.ψ ≤ δ

    29	/-- The real fourth root is nonnegative on all of `ℝ`. For `x < 0` the real power
    30	`x ^ (1/4)` is defined as `|x| ^ (1/4) * cos (π/4)`, which is positive, and for
    31	`0 ≤ x` it is the usual fourth root. The estimates of `lem:qld-4-13` are stated
    32	with quarter powers of error quantities whose nonnegativity is not always
    33	available at the point of use, so the bound is recorded without a sign
    34	hypothesis. -/
    35	theorem rpow_quarter_nonneg (x : ℝ) : 0 ≤ Real.rpow x (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by
    36	  change 0 ≤ x ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ)
    37	  rcases lt_or_ge x 0 with hx | hx
    38	  · rw [Real.rpow_def_of_neg hx,
    39	      show (1 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.pi = Real.pi / 4 by ring, Real.cos_pi_div_four]

    41	  · exact Real.rpow_nonneg hx _

    43	/-- Converting a square root of a sum of two deficit terms into quarter powers.
    44	For `m ≥ 1` and nonnegative `δP, δQ`,
    45	\[
    46	  \sqrt{2\sqrt{4m^2\delta_P}+2\sqrt{4\delta_Q}}
    47	    \le 2\sqrt{m}\,(\delta_P^{1/4}+\delta_Q^{1/4}).
    48	\]

    50	quarter power up to the factor `2√m`; the hypothesis `1 ≤ m` lets the second
    51	summand absorb the same prefactor. This is the scalar step that turns the
    52	Cauchy--Schwarz square root in the overlap estimates into the quarter-power form
    53	in which the first-route error of `lem:qld-4-13` is stated. -/
    54	theorem sqrt_deficit_bound_le (m δP δQ : ℝ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hP : 0 ≤ δP)
    55	    (hQ : 0 ≤ δQ) :
    56	    Real.sqrt (2 * Real.sqrt (4 * m ^ 2 * δP) + 2 * Real.sqrt (4 * δQ)) ≤
    57	      2 * Real.sqrt m * (Real.rpow δP (1 / 4 : ℝ) + Real.rpow δQ (1 / 4 : ℝ)) := by
    58	  have hm0 : 0 ≤ m := by linarith
    59	  have hsqrtm : 1 ≤ Real.sqrt m := by
    60	    rw [← Real.sqrt_one]
    61	    exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hm
    62	  have h1 : Real.sqrt (4 * m ^ 2 * δP) = 2 * m * Real.sqrt δP := by
    63	    rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity), show (4 * m ^ 2 : ℝ) = (2 * m) ^ 2 by ring,
    64	      Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)]
    65	  have h2 : Real.sqrt (4 * δQ) = 2 * Real.sqrt δQ := by
    66	    rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num), show (4 : ℝ) = 2 ^ 2 by norm_num,
    67	      Real.sqrt_sq (by norm_num)]
    68	  have hquarter : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x →
    69	      Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt x) = Real.rpow x (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by
    70	    intro x hx
    71	    rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_mul hx]
    72	    norm_num
    73	  have hsplit : ∀ a b : ℝ, 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b →
    74	      Real.sqrt (a + b) ≤ Real.sqrt a + Real.sqrt b := by
    75	    intro a b ha hb
    76	    rw [← Real.sqrt_sq (add_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg a) (Real.sqrt_nonneg b))]
    77	    refine Real.sqrt_le_sqrt ?_
    78	    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt ha, Real.sq_sqrt hb, Real.sqrt_nonneg a,
    79	      Real.sqrt_nonneg b]
    80	  have hPa : 0 ≤ 2 * (2 * m * Real.sqrt δP) :=
    81	    mul_nonneg (by norm_num)
    82	      (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hm0) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
    83	  have hQa : 0 ≤ 2 * (2 * Real.sqrt δQ) :=
    84	    mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
    85	  have hPb : Real.sqrt (2 * (2 * m * Real.sqrt δP)) =
    86	      2 * Real.sqrt m * Real.rpow δP (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by
    87	    rw [show 2 * (2 * m * Real.sqrt δP) = 2 ^ 2 * m * Real.sqrt δP by ring,

    89	      Real.sqrt_sq (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2), hquarter δP hP]
    90	  have hQb : Real.sqrt (2 * (2 * Real.sqrt δQ)) = 2 * Real.rpow δQ (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by
    91	    rw [show 2 * (2 * Real.sqrt δQ) = 2 ^ 2 * Real.sqrt δQ by ring,
    92	      Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ 2),
    93	      Real.sqrt_sq (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2), hquarter δQ hQ]
    94	  rw [h1, h2]
    95	  calc
    96	    Real.sqrt (2 * (2 * m * Real.sqrt δP) + 2 * (2 * Real.sqrt δQ))

    98	          Real.sqrt (2 * (2 * Real.sqrt δQ)) := hsplit _ _ hPa hQa

   102	          (Real.rpow δP (1 / 4 : ℝ) + Real.rpow δQ (1 / 4 : ℝ)) := by
   103	      have hQ4 : 0 ≤ Real.rpow δQ (1 / 4 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_nonneg hQ _
   104	      nlinarith [hsqrtm, hQ4]

   106	/-- Additive polynomial errors remain polynomial after conditioning and insertion

   108	for normalized POVM consistency, not a replacement measurement. This scalar lemma
   109	supports `lem:qld-xz-lines`, paper lines 950--963; see issue #118 and
   110	`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_combined-lines-error-term.tex`. -/
   111	theorem exists_conditioned_polynomial_bound (pointError : ℝ → ℝ)
   112	    (hpoint : IsPolyErr pointError) (constant : ℝ) (hconstant : 1 ≤ constant)
   113	    (pastingError : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (hpasting : IsPolyErr₂ pastingError) :
   114	    ∃ lineError : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, IsPolyErr₂ lineError ∧
   115	      ∀ error ratio mass : ℝ, 0 ≤ error → 0 ≤ ratio →
   116	        1 / 2 ≤ mass → mass ≤ 1 →
   117	        min 1 (mass * pastingError ratio
   118	          ((8 * pointError error + constant * (error + Real.sqrt error)) / mass) + ratio) ≤
   119	          lineError error ratio := by
   120	  obtain ⟨pointConstant, pointPower, hpointConstant, hpointPower, hpointBound⟩ := hpoint
   121	  obtain ⟨pastingConstant, ratioPower, marginalPower, hpastingConstant,
   122	    hratioPower, hmarginalPower, hpastingBound⟩ := hpasting
   123	  let smallPower := min pointPower (1 / 2 : ℝ)
   124	  let finalRatioPower := min ratioPower 1
   125	  let marginalConstant := 8 * pointConstant + 2 * constant
   126	  let powerConstant := (2 * marginalConstant) ^ marginalPower
   127	  let finalConstant := pastingConstant * (1 + powerConstant) + 1
   128	  have hsmall : 0 < smallPower := lt_min hpointPower (by norm_num)
   129	  have hfinalRatio : 0 < finalRatioPower := lt_min hratioPower zero_lt_one
   130	  have hmarginalConstant : 0 ≤ marginalConstant := by dsimp [marginalConstant]; linarith
   131	  have hpowerConstant : 0 ≤ powerConstant := Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _
   132	  have hfinalConstant : 1 ≤ finalConstant := by
   133	    dsimp [finalConstant]
   134	    nlinarith
   135	  refine ⟨fun error ratio => finalConstant *
   136	    (error ^ (smallPower * marginalPower) + ratio ^ finalRatioPower),
   137	    ⟨finalConstant, smallPower * marginalPower, finalRatioPower, hfinalConstant,
   138	      mul_pos hsmall hmarginalPower, hfinalRatio, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
   139	  · intro error ratio herror hratio
   140	    exact ⟨mul_nonneg (by linarith) (add_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg herror _)
   141	      (Real.rpow_nonneg hratio _)), le_rfl⟩
   142	  intro error ratio mass herror hratio hmass hmassOne
   143	  have hmassPos : 0 < mass := by linarith
   144	  have herrorPower : 0 ≤ error ^ (smallPower * marginalPower) :=
   145	    Real.rpow_nonneg herror _
   146	  have hratioPowerNonneg : 0 ≤ ratio ^ finalRatioPower := Real.rpow_nonneg hratio _
   147	  have hlarge (hlarge : 1 ≤ error ^ (smallPower * marginalPower) +

   150	        ((8 * pointError error + constant * (error + Real.sqrt error)) / mass) + ratio) ≤

   152	          ratio ^ finalRatioPower) := by

   154	    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ finalConstant - 1 by linarith)

   202	        (div_nonneg hmarginalNonneg hmassPos.le)
   203	      refine (min_le_right _ _).trans ?_
   204	      calc

   207	            ratio := add_le_add (mul_le_of_le_one_left hpastingValue.1 hmassOne) le_rfl

   209	            powerConstant * error ^ (smallPower * marginalPower)) +
   210	            ratio ^ finalRatioPower :=
   211	          add_le_add (hpastingValue.2.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
   212	            (add_le_add hratioSmall hdivPower) (by linarith))) hratioLinear
   213	        _ ≤ _ := by
   214	          dsimp [finalConstant]
   215	          nlinarith [mul_nonneg
   216	            (mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ pastingConstant by linarith) hpowerConstant)
   217	            hratioPowerNonneg,
   218	            mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ pastingConstant by linarith) herrorPower]
   219	    · apply hlarge
   220	      linarith [Real.one_le_rpow (le_of_not_ge hratioOne) hfinalRatio.le]
   221	  · apply hlarge
   222	    linarith [Real.one_le_rpow (le_of_not_ge herrorOne)
   223	      (mul_pos hsmall hmarginalPower).le]

   225	/-- Polynomial absorption for the first combining route, including large errors.
   226	The independent unit bound on consistency accounts for the minimum. The factor
   227	`dimension` is retained, as required by the correction to `lem:qld-4-13` in
   228	`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_combined-lines-error-term.tex`, paper lines 1134--1246. -/
   229	theorem exists_combining_polynomial_bound (pointError : ℝ → ℝ)
   230	    (hpoint : IsPolyErr pointError) (lineError : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)
   231	    (hline : IsPolyErr₂ lineError) (constant : ℝ) (hconstant : 0 ≤ constant) :
   232	    ∃ combinedError : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, IsPolyErr₂ combinedError ∧
   233	      ∀ error ratio dimension : ℝ, 0 ≤ error → 0 ≤ ratio → 1 ≤ dimension →
   234	        min 1 (constant * ((pointError error) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) + Real.sqrt dimension *
   235	          ((lineError error ratio) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) + (pointError error) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) +
   236	            error ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ)))) ≤ dimension * combinedError error ratio := by
   237	  obtain ⟨pointConstant, pointPower, hpointConstant, hpointPower, hpointBound⟩ := hpoint
   238	  obtain ⟨lineConstant, errorPower, ratioPower, hlineConstant,
   239	    herrorPower, hratioPower, hlineBound⟩ := hline
   240	  let finalPower := min (pointPower / 4) (min (errorPower / 4) (1 / 4 : ℝ))
   241	  let coefficient := pointConstant ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) + lineConstant ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) +
   242	    pointConstant ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) + 1
   243	  let finalConstant := 1 + constant * coefficient
   244	  have hfinalPower : 0 < finalPower := by dsimp [finalPower]; positivity
   245	  have hcoefficient : 0 ≤ coefficient := by dsimp [coefficient]; positivity
   246	  have hfinalConstant : 1 ≤ finalConstant := by
   247	    dsimp [finalConstant]
   248	    linarith [mul_nonneg hconstant hcoefficient]
   249	  refine ⟨fun error ratio => finalConstant *
   250	    (error ^ finalPower + ratio ^ (ratioPower / 4)),

+/-- The real fourth root is nonnegative on all of `ℝ`. For `x < 0` the real power
+`x ^ (1/4)` is defined as `|x| ^ (1/4) * cos (π/4)`, which is positive, and for
+`0 ≤ x` it is the usual fourth root. The estimates of `lem:qld-4-13` are stated
+with quarter powers of error quantities whose nonnegativity is not always
+available at the point of use, so the bound is recorded without a sign
+hypothesis. -/
+theorem rpow_quarter_nonneg (x : ℝ) : 0 ≤ Real.rpow x (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by
+  change 0 ≤ x ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ)
+  rcases lt_or_ge x 0 with hx | hx
+  · rw [Real.rpow_def_of_neg hx,
+      show (1 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.pi = Real.pi / 4 by ring, Real.cos_pi_div_four]
+    positivity
+  · exact Real.rpow_nonneg hx _

+/-- Converting a square root of a sum of two deficit terms into quarter powers.
+For `m ≥ 1` and nonnegative `δP, δQ`,
+\[
+  \sqrt{2\sqrt{4m^2\delta_P}+2\sqrt{4\delta_Q}}
+    \le 2\sqrt{m}\,(\delta_P^{1/4}+\delta_Q^{1/4}).
+\]
+Subadditivity of the square root separates the two summands, each of which is a
+quarter power up to the factor `2√m`; the hypothesis `1 ≤ m` lets the second

   obtain ⟨pastingConstant, ratioPower, marginalPower, hpastingConstant,

   let finalRatioPower := min ratioPower 1

   let powerConstant := (2 * marginalConstant) ^ marginalPower

   have hfinalRatio : 0 < finalRatioPower := lt_min hratioPower zero_lt_one

     dsimp [finalConstant]

    36	theorem pointConsistency_eq_mismatch {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
    37	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (W : PauliKind) :
    38	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
    39	        (fun u a => heteroKron ((S.pointMeas .alice W u).effect a) 1)
    40	        (fun u a => heteroKron 1 ((S.pointMeas .bob W u).effect a))
    41	        S.toStrategy.ψ =
    42	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (fun u =>
    43	        outcomeEventWeight S.toStrategy
    44	          (ProjectiveSetting.pointQuestion P W u)
    45	          (ProjectiveSetting.pointQuestion P W u)
    46	          (fun A B => ProjectiveSetting.pointAnswerOrZero A ≠
    47	            ProjectiveSetting.pointAnswerOrZero B)) := by
    48	  let X := Fin P.m → PauliScalar P
    49	  let q : X → PauliQuestion P := fun u => ProjectiveSetting.pointQuestion P W u
    50	  let f : X → PauliAnswer P → PauliScalar P := fun _ =>
    51	    ProjectiveSetting.pointAnswerOrZero
    52	  have h := WinImplications.consistencyDefect_postprocess_eq_mismatch
    53	    (X := X) (uniformDistribution X) S.toStrategy q q f f
    54	  have hA : ∀ (u : X) c,
    55	      heteroKron ((S.pointMeas .alice W u).effect c)
    56	          (1 : Op S.toStrategy.ιB) =
    57	        heteroKron (((S.toStrategy.A (q u)).postprocess (f u)).effect c)
    58	          (1 : Op S.toStrategy.ιB) := by
    59	    intro u c
    60	    rfl
    61	  have hB : ∀ (u : X) c,
    62	      heteroKron (1 : Op S.toStrategy.ιA)
    63	          ((S.pointMeas .bob W u).effect c) =
    64	        heteroKron (1 : Op S.toStrategy.ιA)
    65	          (((S.toStrategy.B (q u)).postprocess (f u)).effect c) := by
    66	    intro u c
    67	    rfl
    68	  calc
    69	    _ = consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution X)
    70	        (fun u c => heteroKron
    71	          (((S.toStrategy.A (q u)).postprocess (f u)).effect c) 1)
    72	        (fun u c => heteroKron 1
    73	          (((S.toStrategy.B (q u)).postprocess (f u)).effect c))
    74	        S.toStrategy.ψ :=
    75	          consistencyDefect_congr _ _ _ _ _ _ hA hB
    76	    _ = avgOver (uniformDistribution X) (fun u =>
    77	        outcomeEventWeight S.toStrategy (q u) (q u)
    78	          (fun A B => f u A ≠ f u B)) := h
    79	    _ = _ := by rfl

    83	used at paper `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:455-465`. -/
    84	theorem point_self_consistency_le {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
    85	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (W : PauliKind) :
    86	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
    87	        (fun u a => heteroKron ((S.pointMeas .alice W u).effect a) 1)
    88	        (fun u a => heteroKron 1 ((S.pointMeas .bob W u).effect a))
    89	        S.toStrategy.ψ ≤ (Fintype.card PauliEdge : ℝ) * ε := by
    90	  rw [pointConsistency_eq_mismatch]
    91	  have hsource :
    92	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (fun u =>
    93	          outcomeEventWeight S.toStrategy
    94	            (ProjectiveSetting.pointQuestion P W u)
    95	            (ProjectiveSetting.pointQuestion P W u)
    96	            (fun A B => ProjectiveSetting.pointAnswerOrZero A ≠
    97	              ProjectiveSetting.pointAnswerOrZero B)) =
    98	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (PauliSpace P)) (fun z =>
    99	          outcomeEventWeight S.toStrategy
   100	            (ProjectiveSetting.pointQuestion P W (pauliToLd P W z).point)
   101	            (ProjectiveSetting.pointQuestion P W (pauliToLd P W z).point)
   102	            (fun A B => ProjectiveSetting.pointAnswerOrZero A ≠
   103	              ProjectiveSetting.pointAnswerOrZero B)) := by
   104	    let g : (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) → ℝ := fun u =>

   106	        (ProjectiveSetting.pointQuestion P W u)
   107	        (ProjectiveSetting.pointQuestion P W u)
   108	        (fun A B => ProjectiveSetting.pointAnswerOrZero A ≠
   109	          ProjectiveSetting.pointAnswerOrZero B)
   110	    have hld := WinImplications.avgOver_pauliToLd_uniform P W (fun z => g z.point)
   111	    have hpoint := WinImplications.avgOver_ldPoint_uniform P.toLdParams g
   112	    exact (hld.trans hpoint).symm
   113	  rw [hsource]
   114	  calc
   115	    _ ≤ avgOver (uniformDistribution (PauliSpace P))
   116	        (WinImplications.pauliRejectionAt S.toStrategy
   117	          (WinImplications.pauliLoopEdge (.point W))) := by
   118	      apply avgOver_mono
   119	      intro z
   120	      refine le_trans ?_
   121	        (WinImplications.loopMismatch_le_rejection S (.point W) z)
   122	      apply outcome_event_weight_mono
   123	      intro A B hne hAB
   124	      exact hne (congrArg ProjectiveSetting.pointAnswerOrZero hAB)
   125	    _ ≤ (Fintype.card PauliEdge : ℝ) * ε :=
   126	      WinImplications.fixedEdgeRejection_le_error S _

   100	      setting.ExpandedLocalSpace first.side ×

   104	    (hsecond : ∀ operator : Op (setting.ExpandedLocalSpace second.side),
   105	      reindexOp equivalence (heteroKron 1 (heteroKron operator
   106	        (1 : Op (PauliRegister params × PauliRegister params)))) =
   107	        setting.place second operator)

   109	    [Fintype answer] [DecidableEq answer] (law : Distribution question)
   110	    (firstFamily : question → answer → Op (setting.ExpandedLocalSpace first.side))
   111	    (secondFamily : question → answer → Op (setting.ExpandedLocalSpace second.side)) :
   112	    consistencyDefect law (fun query output => heteroKron (firstFamily query output) 1)
   113	      (fun query output => heteroKron 1 (heteroKron (secondFamily query output)
   114	        (1 : Op (PauliRegister params × PauliRegister params))))

   116	    consistencyDefect law (fun query output => setting.place first (firstFamily query output))

   119	  congr 1
   120	  funext query
   121	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   122	  intro output _
   123	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl

    23	/-- The first-line nondegeneracy event has positive mass under the product

    26	    0 < ∑ samples ∈
    27	        (Distribution.prod (linePointDist L) (linePointDist L)).support.filter

    29	      (Distribution.prod (linePointDist L) (linePointDist L)).weight samples := by
    30	  change 0 < nondegenerateLinePastingMass L

    37	      (LineDesc L × (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L))) ×

item.text: The conditioned pasting instantiation is coherent: the law is relabeled as `((lineX,lineZ), (lineZ,zPoint), (lineX,xPoint))`, the collision bound is applied only to the nonzero X direction, and the output swap restores the public X/Z answer order. I am checking the final scalar absorption next, especially the `min 1` fallback and the conversion of discarded mass into the `md/q` parameter, because that is where a formally valid proof can still hide a wrong asymptotic contract.

 \section{The domain of the conditional Lean helper}
 
 The source statement does not take an arbitrary joint point measurement as an
 input.  It uses the family $\{\hat Q^{x,z}_{a,b}\}$ constructed by the preceding
 point lemma, whose error has the form $\delta_Q(\eps)=\poly(\eps)$.  Consequently,
 an internal theorem which accepts an already constructed point witness must retain
 the same quantitative dependency: it should first fix a function
 $\delta_Q:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ satisfying the one-variable polynomial-error
 predicate, then choose $\delta_P$, and at strategy error $\eps$ accept only a
 point witness with bound $\delta_Q(\eps)$.
 
 Before the repair tracked by \ghissue{389}, the Lean helper
 \path{exists_combinedLinesWitness_ofPointsWitness} instead had the quantifier
 order
 \[
   \exists\delta_P=\poly(\eps,md/q)\quad
   \forall\eps\ \forall\delta_Q\ \forall Q,
   \qquad Q\text{ has point error at most }\delta_Q
   \Longrightarrow T\text{ has line error at most }\delta_P(\eps,md/q).
 \]
 Thus the line-error function was chosen before an unrestricted scalar
 $\delta_Q$, and did not depend on it.  The fields of
 \path{CombinedPointsWitness} bound self-consistency and the two ordered-product
 comparisons by precisely this scalar; they impose no relation between an
 arbitrary $\delta_Q$ and $\eps$.  The conditioned-pasting estimate therefore
 cannot eliminate $\delta_Q$ from its conclusion.

   131	Before the repair tracked by \ghissue{389}, the Lean helper
   132	\path{exists_combinedLinesWitness_ofPointsWitness} instead had the quantifier

   228	$c=\alpha a+\beta b$. Claim~17-1 explicitly retains the point error.

   232	lines~689--709, 993--1018, and 1140--1173.}
   233	
   234	Take $m=d=1$, $\eps=0$, and let $q=2^{2k+1}>2$ tend to infinity.
   235	These parameters are admissible. The Pauli basis test has a perfect projective strategy by
   236	\path{lem:pauli-completeness}.\footnote{See
   237	\path{references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex},
   238	lines~1229--1421, for the construction; the statement and its projective Pauli
   239	measurements appear at lines~1232--1255.}
   240	Let $\hat\psi$ be its normalized expanded state. On each player's expanded
   241	local space, define the supplied joint point measurement by
   242	\[
   243	 Q^{x,z}_{a,b}=
   244	 \begin{cases}
   245	   \Id,&(a,b)=(x^2,0),\\
   246	   0,&\text{otherwise}.
   247	 \end{cases}
   248	\]
   249	This is a complete projective measurement and is exactly self-consistent in
   250	every opposite placement. The finitely many averaged squared distances from the
   251	two ordered expanded point products are finite real numbers. Taking their
   252	maximum and zero gives a scalar $\delta_Q$ satisfying all the fields of the
   253	point witness. No estimate of this scalar in terms of $\eps$ is required.
   254	
   255	The extended point answer is $\alpha x^2$. In dimension $2m+2=4$, the directly
   256	indexed line-point law assigns weight $1/2$ to axis lines and then chooses one
   257	of the four coordinates uniformly. Its X-axis branch therefore has mass $1/8$.
   258	On that branch, $z,\alpha,\beta$ are fixed along the line, while $x$ is uniform
   259	in the field. The canonical base has X coordinate zero, so the affine line
   260	parameter is exactly $x$. For $\alpha\ne0$, every permitted line answer $p$
   261	has degree at most one, and $p(X)-\alpha X^2$ is a nonzero polynomial of degree
   262	two. It has at most two roots, hence its agreement with the point answer is at
   263	most $2/q$.

   314	\section{The source assertion and the two routes}

   316	The source proof in \cite{Ji2020MIPStar} constructs $\hat Q^{\ell}_f$ by

   318	provided by its sub-line lemma, the pushforward of
   319	$T^{\ell_X,\ell_Z}$ along a combining map, and reduces the lemma to a
   320	bound on the scalar consistency defect

   322	  \Lambda \,=\,
   323	  \E_{(\ell,\ell_X,\ell_Z) \sim D}\
   324	  \E_{(x,z,\alpha,\beta) \in \ell}
   325	  \sum_{f_X,f_Z} \bra{\hat\psi}
   326	  \big(T^{\ell_X,\ell_Z}_{f_X,f_Z}\big)_{\mathsf{A}\mathsf{A}'} \ot
   327	  \big(\Id - \hat{Q}^{x,z}_{f_X(x),f_Z(z)}\big)_{\mathsf{B}\mathsf{A}''}
   328	  \ket{\hat\psi}\,,
   329	  \tag{\path{eq:qld-combined-lines-consistency}}

   332	ranges over pairs of line polynomials.  The proof then bounds $\Lambda$
   333	twice, by different routes and with different results, and the printed
   334	record is internally inconsistent: the display introducing $\Lambda$
   335	asserts the first-route bound, while the closing lines assert the
   336	second-route bound as the operative one; the lemma statement claims a
   337	third form matching neither.

   339	\paragraph{The first route.}

   341	$\hat Q^{x,z}$ is replaced by the ordered product of the two point
   342	measurements at cost $\delta_Q^{1/2}$; the $X$-point factor is removed at
   343	cost $m\,\delta_{\mathrm{Line}}^{1/2}$; and the remaining $Z$-point
   344	correlation is shown to be within
   345	$\sqrt{m}\,(\delta_P^{1/4} + \delta_Q^{1/4} + \eps^{1/4})$ of one.  The
   346	factors of $m$ enter through the mixture structure of the sub-line
   347	distribution: each restricted line distribution carries mixture weight

   349	$\delta$ over the full distribution is bounded only by $2m\delta$ over a
   350	restricted component and by $4m^2\delta$ over a product of two

   397	\section{Why neither route yields the stated form}

   399	The stated error form is $\poly(m^2\eps, md/q)$, a function of the two
   400	quantities $m^2\eps$ and $md/q$ that vanishes as both vanish.  The
   401	first-route bound is not dominated by any such function: along the
   402	scaling $\eps = m^{-4}$ with $q/(md) \to \infty$, both $m^2\eps = m^{-2}$
   403	and $md/q$ tend to $0$, while the term $m\,\eps^{1/4} = 1$ does not.
   404	Hence the established derivation supports no bound of the claimed form.

   406	first-route term is capped by the independent unit bound on consistency.

   112	 \sum_{a,b}\|(Q_{a,b}-M^X_aM^Z_b)\widehat\psi\|^2
   113	 &\leq 2\sum_{a,b}\|Q_{a,b}\widehat\psi\|^2\\
   114	 &\quad+2\sum_{a,b}\|M^X_aM^Z_b\widehat\psi\|^2\\
   115	 &=4.
   116	\end{align*}
   117	The reversed ordering satisfies the same calculation. Hence $\delta_Q=4$
   118	is allowed by every point-witness field. These constants are permitted by
   119	the former scalar quantifiers; the argument does not require them to be
   120	polynomially small functions of $\eps$.
   121	
   122	For each supported subline sample, completeness gives
   123	\[
   124	 A(T)=q^{-2}\sum_{a,b}\langle\widehat\psi,
   125	    (I\ot M^Z_bM^X_a)\widehat\psi\rangle=q^{-2},
   126	 \qquad
   127	 B(T)=q^{-2}\sum_{a,b}\langle\widehat\psi,
   128	    (I\ot M^Z_b)\widehat\psi\rangle=q^{-1}.
   129	\]
   130	The first equality uses $\sum_bM^Z_b\sum_aM^X_a=I$, without a commutation
   131	assumption. Probability averaging preserves these constants. The absolute
   132	difference is therefore $(q-1)/q^2>0$, whereas the claimed bound is zero at
   133	$\eps=0$. For $q=8$ the difference is $7/64$. The same perfect strategy is
   134	admissible at arbitrarily small positive $\eps$, so excluding zero or
   135	enlarging a universal constant cannot repair the claim. No polynomially
   136	vanishing error depending on $\eps$ alone absorbs this difference.
